deadline.value: December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; fall admission only.
deadline.quote: APPLICATION DEADLINE FOR FALL 2027 IS DECEMBER 1, 2026

app_fee.quote: The non-refundable graduate application fee is $65 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: A waiver code exists for domestic applicants; international students are not eligible for Fall 2027.
fee_waiver.quote: International students are not eligible for a fee waiver for Fall 2027.

supervisor.value: The page asks applicants to identify potential faculty mentors but does not say a supervisor is required before admission.

funding.value: PhD students in good standing receive up to five years of support as teaching or research assistants, with a stipend of USD 39,063 in 2026-27 and tuition coverage.
funding.quote: All Ph.D. students in good academic standing receive up to five years of financial support, either as a Teaching Assistant or as a Research Assistant.

entry_route.value: The page does not state whether a master's degree is needed.

notes: Ecology, Evolution and Organismal Biology and Molecular, Cellular and Evolutionary Biology PhD programs. These are separate from the Bioscience PhD programs that limit international applicants.
